2609.40285.title: PivotOPD: Learning to Recover from Pivotal Mistakes in Multi-Turn Agents
2609.40285.paper_summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for training language agents, providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, in multi-turn interaction, an incorrect action changes the states the student encounters later, so errors compound across turns. In preliminary experiments across three Qwen3 models (8B to 235B), we find that more than half of the failed rollouts contain a pivotal mistake, an action that moves the agent farther from completing the task, and this mistake typically occurs early. These pivotal mistakes often remain recoverable: guiding the model for only a few turns after the pivotal turn can restore task success. We therefore propose PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation framework that jointly trains the student to prevent pivotal mistakes and to recover from the states they create. At each pivotal mistake, a teacher model provides a gold action and then names a recovery action at each of the next few turns. Preventive distillation uses the gold action with reverse KL to steer the student away from the pivotal mistake, while recovery distillation uses the recovery actions with forward KL to transfer recovery behaviors that the student rarely samples. Against 13 baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA, PivotOPD achieves the strongest average performance for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-8B students, improving over the strongest baseline on ALFWorld by +5.5% with the 1.7B student. The gains also transfer to another model family on the software engineering domain, where PivotOPD raises the resolve rate of a Nemotron-3.5 student on SWE-Bench Verified by +3.2%. Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/pivotopd/
2609.40285.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）中，這是一種有前景的方法，用於訓練語言代理，為學生生成的軌跡提供密集的教師監督。<lb/>然而，在多輪互動中，不正確的行動會改變學生後續遇到的狀態，因此錯誤會在多輪中累積。<lb/>在對三個 Qwen3 模型（8B 到 235B）的初步實驗中，我們發現超過一半的失敗回合包含一個關鍵錯誤，即一個使代理更遠離完成任務的行動，而這個錯誤通常發生在早期。<lb/>這些關鍵錯誤往往是可恢復的：在關鍵回合之後僅指導模型幾輪即可恢復任務成功。<lb/>因此，我們提出了 PivotOPD，一個政策蒸餾框架，聯合訓練學生以防止關鍵錯誤並從其創造的狀態中恢復。<lb/>在每個關鍵錯誤中，教師模型提供一個金標行動，然後在接下來的幾輪中指定一個恢復行動。<lb/>預防性蒸餾使用金標行動與反向 KL 來引導學生遠離關鍵錯誤，而恢復性蒸餾則使用恢復行動與正向 KL 來轉移學生很少採樣的恢復行為。<lb/>在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和基於搜索的 QA 上對 13 個基準進行測試，PivotOPD 為 Qwen3-1.7B 和 Qwen3-8B 學生實現了最強的平均性能，並在 1.7B 學生上將 ALFWorld 上最強基準提高了 +5.5%。<lb/>這些增益也轉移到另一個模型系列的軟體工程領域，其中 PivotOPD 將 Nemotron-3.5 學生在 SWE-Bench Verified 上的解決率提高了 +3.2%。<lb/>項目頁面：https://research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/pivotopd/
